title: Carlsberg India IPO
summary: Carlsberg India IPO is a book-built issue of 8.64 crore shares, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Carlsberg India IPO has a total issue size of 8,64,18,887 shares and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: Kotak Mahindra Capital Co.Ltd., JP Morgan India Pvt.Ltd., Citigroup Global Markets India Pvt.Ltd.

Carlsberg India financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Carlsberg India Limited was incorporated on May 3, 2006. The Company is involved in the manufacturing, marketing and distribution of beer and other alcoholic beverages in India. Carlsberg India Limited is part of the Carlsberg Group, which is an international brewing company with a long tradition in the global alcoholic beverages industry. The Company provides a range of internationally recognized beer brands in the super-premium, premium and mainstream categories such as Carlsberg, Tuborg and 1664 Blanc. The core activities of the Company comprise brand development, product innovation, quality control and distribution to cater for diverse consumer preferences in Indian markets. · · As of June 30, 2026, the Company operated with the help of seven owned breweries and contract manufacturers. The Company had a distribution network covering approximately 80,000 licensed outlets with sales personnel and a cluster based approach to the market. The Company makes use of its strategically located manufacturing facilities combined with an efficient supply chain. · · The Company benefits from the brewing experience, high quality standards, brand building capability and other assistance provided by the Carlsberg Group. · · As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 1,274 permanent employees and 205 contract employees.
Carlsberg A/S, South Asian Breweries Pte.Ltd. are the company's promoters of Carlsberg India.
